title: Small defense contractors face CMMC assessment and annual affirmation costs

history.reason: Primary rule read; DoD cost estimates and small-entity counts recorded.
Review correction: separated existing security-compliance baseline from unquantified remediation; qualified contract/phase applicability and awardee baseline.

description: Small DoD contractors and subcontractors can face CMMC assessment and affirmation requirements when the applicable acquisition contract requirements and phase-in apply. The October 2024 program rule estimates five- to six-figure Level 2 assessment costs for a small entity; this is not verified current demand or measured actual spend.
customer_segment: Small DoD contractors and subcontractors with applicable CMMC requirements at the required level and phase. The 23,475 small-entity count is the rule's DFARS 252.204-7012 awardee baseline, not a verified count currently needing CMMC assessments.
context: Regulatory requirement published October 2024; applicability depends on contract clauses and phase-in. Who decides and pays for compliance help inside small firms is not established.

evidence.text: DoD estimates 23,475 small entities (75% of 31,338 unique awardees) receive awards under contracts containing DFARS 252.204-7012.
DoD estimates a Level 2 certification assessment plus affirmation costs a small entity $101,752 and a Level 2 self-assessment plus affirmation $34,277.

DoD excludes underlying security-control implementation from the CMMC rule cost figures because FAR 52.204-21 and DFARS 252.204-7012 already require applicable controls; its baseline assumes those implementation costs should already have been incurred.

A contractor that has not met its pre-existing security obligations might still incur remediation expense, but that expense and its attribution to incremental CMMC requirements are not quantified here.
Small contractors may pay for tooling or services that reduce assessment preparation effort.

alternatives: Compliance consultants, managed security providers and GRC software vendors: not yet investigated.

contradictory_evidence.text: All cost figures are the regulator's own ex ante estimates; actual costs, and how many firms exit or never bid, are unknown.
Existing assessment and compliance vendors may already serve this need; competitor coverage and pricing are unknown.

uncertainty: Unknown: actual spend, remediation cost, current phase-in dates, buyer and budget, competitor coverage, and whether the problem is assessment preparation or control implementation.
open_questions: What do small contractors actually spend on CMMC preparation (independent of DoD estimates)?
Which parts are repetitive documentation versus technical remediation?
What are the current phase-in dates?
next_actions: Find independent surveys or small-business trade-group data on CMMC readiness and spend.
Review public pricing and scope of existing CMMC compliance vendors.
